$comment: Catalog of available Microverse brand themes — reference/documentation, not read by the build. Each theme is a dir under this one, always shaped the same way by convention: css/light.css + css/dark.css (required), images/<anything> (optional, exactly one file — the theme's own background photo; themes with none, like Default, just don't have an images/ folder). Selecting a theme means setting MICROVERSE_BRAND_THEME to its dir name (see root .env / .env.example) — applications/taskfusion/Dockerfile and infrastructure/keycloak/Dockerfile both copy only that one theme's files into fixed, theme-agnostic destination paths at build time (rewriting [data-brand-theme="<id>"] to bare :root, and overwriting the canonical images/microverse-bg.jpg only if that theme has its own image) — see either Dockerfile's comments for the exact mechanism. Neither app's own source code (nor Keycloak's static theme files) ever reference a theme id directly.

themes.label: Default
themes.description: Base Microverse theme, blue primary. No cultural narrative by design — every other theme starts here and swaps the palette.

themes.label: Vienna
themes.description: Schönbrunn/Belvedere palette — pine hedge-green primary, spring-green live-status accent, Schönbrunn ochre as the single warm accent.

themes.label: Uhuru
themes.description: Pan-African red/gold/green/black palette — ember-red primary, savanna-green live-status accent, dawn gold as the single warm accent.
